locale.name: en_US
locale.message: JMEF XML Generator

The plugin extends the basic metadata for the journal to enable the creation of XML in the Journal Metadata Exchange Format (JMEF). The metadata can be filled in the plugin settings after it is activated. The generated XML address will be [journal URL]/jmef (e.g. https://ojs.yourjournal.com/jmef)
Review type
Choose type of your review process from the list
Journal's DOI
Fill in the journal's DOI in the format 10.xxxx/xxxx (e.g. 10.1234/abcdefgh)
Journal's DDH ID
If the journal is in DDH, please enter the DDH ID number.
Journal's DOAJ ID
If the journal is in DOAJ, please enter the DOAJ ID number.
Publisher location
You have filled this publisher name in the settings: {$publisherName}
Select the country where the publisher is based.
Journal keywords
Enter keywords describing your journal, separated by ;
Check if you have open authorship.
Journal policy
Diamond criteria
Additional Journal Metadata
Other organisations
The owner of the journal, if it is different from the publisher, or other organisations associated with the journal, separated by ;
OECD 2007 Classification
Choose your journal's classification from the list.
Check if your journal could be classified as Scholarly journal.
Check if your journal is community owned.
Check if your journal has no APCs and any kind of subscriptions to it's content.
